data.summary: Marriott International (MAR) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: Our increased reliance on cloud-based services and on remote access to information systems and our use of AI and other emerging technologies increases the Company's exposure to potential cybersecurity incidents.

Disruptions in or changes to these systems, including during upgrades or replacements, could result in a disruption to our business and the loss of important data. 16 Table of Contents We are incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into certain of our processes, offerings, and services, and these technologies may become increasingly important in our operations over time.
